basic_details.short_information: Indian Institute of Science Education and Research Pune (IISER Pune) has published the Project Assistant Notification 2026 under Advertisement No. 57/2026. The recruitment drive aims to fill 2 Project Assistant positions on a contractual basis. Candidates up to 35 years of age and holding an M.Sc. or MS in Geology, Geophysics, Physics, Atmospheric Sciences, or allied subjects are eligible to attend the walk-in interview on 31-07-2026. Candidates can easily access the official notification PDF and interview details below..

Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for IISER Pune Project Assistant Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IISER Pune Project Assistant recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is through a walk-in interview. Candidates need to attend the interview on the specified date, which is 31-07-2026. There is no separate application submission deadline mentioned.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Project Assistant post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an M.Sc. or MS degree in Geology, Geophysics, Physics, Atmospheric Sciences, or allied subjects to be eligible for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Project Assistant position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Project Assistant post is 35 years. Age relaxation may be provided as per government norms.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Project Assistant role?
faq.answer: The selected candidates for the Project Assistant position will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 25,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available for the Project Assistant post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies announced for the Project Assistant position at IISER Pune.

faq.question: Q6. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The mode of application for this recruitment is Walk-in. Candidates need to attend the interview directly at the specified venue and time.

faq.question: Q7. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: You should carry all original documents, self-attested photocopies of educational certificates, ID proof, and any other relevant documents as mentioned in the notification.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for the Project Assistant post?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the walk-in interview for IISER Pune Project Assistant recruitment going to be held?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held at Indian Institute of Science Education and Research Pune, Maharashtra, Pune - 411008.

faq.question: Q10. What is the selection process for the Project Assistant position?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Project Assistant position will be based on a Walk-in Interview.
